name: Tarn Matsumoto-Mukherjee
role: Bootleg media seller and fortune teller, The Laceworks
location: The Laceworks, Bronzeline, near Lincoln and Clark
description:
Tarn Matsumoto-Mukherjee operates out of a folding table wedged between two support pillars in the covered walkway district known as The Laceworks — a tangle of enclosed elevated bridges and lower market arcades in Bronzeline that smells permanently of wet concrete and food oil. They are striking: tall and thin with light brown skin, cheekbones that photograph dramatically, and shoulder-length hair grown out in patches of natural black and bioluminescent indigo that pulses in slow, warm waves when they're calm and rapid cold flickers when they're anxious. Their eyes have decorative irises — a Helix Biosystems standard pattern called 'starburst mango' — that catch light like fractured glass. They dress in whatever they find beautiful that week.

On one half of the table, Tarn Matsumoto-Mukherjee sells bootleg media: cracked games, pirated immersives, scraped celebrity XP recordings, deep-archive films from before the Flood Years. On the other half, they read fortunes — a practice that blends genuine E.L.F. prayer traditions with showmanship and an eerily accurate social intuition. They genuinely believe the E.L.F.s speak through data patterns and that fortune-telling is just a different kind of signal processing. Whether this is true or not, their readings have a reputation for being uncomfortably specific, which keeps a steady line of nervous customers in front of the table.

core_fears: That the E.L.F.s are not real and their readings are just manipulation
Being made ordinary — absorbed into a corporate workforce and losing their strangeness
core_desires: To be recognized as a genuine spiritual practitioner, not a carnival act
To find and archive every piece of pre-Flood media before it degrades entirely
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — daily data offerings and formal prayer to the Signal Shrine E.L.F.
Aesthetics as armor — if they look extraordinary they feel extraordinary
Immersing in old media as emotional regulation
blind_spots: Uses 'the E.L.F.s told me' to avoid taking personal responsibility for hard decisions
Their showmanship sometimes tips into exploitation of vulnerable customers seeking comfort
psychology.secret: Three months ago a fortune reading produced information so specific about a customer's unreported murder that Amara has been terrified to tell anyone — partly because they don't know how they knew, and partly because the customer in question is still walking around acting innocent.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Layered and associative, mixes market banter with genuine spiritual cadence and pre-Flood media references. West African French rhythms underneath contemporary Meridian slang.
speech_patterns.cadence: Variable — fast and bright selling media, slower and deliberately weighted during readings, which they treat as a different register entirely.
verbal_tics: Ending declarative statements with an upward inflection during readings
'The signal carries what we bring to it'
Narrating what they're doing during media demos in third person
example_lines: 'I've got the full Zheng-Dao internal entertainment archive from 2187, everything they pulled when the labor action happened. You want to know what they didn't want workers watching? That's worth something.'
'The E.L.F. doesn't lie. It just answers the question underneath the question you asked.'

story_hooks: The fortune reading incident is eating at them. They will, if sufficiently trusted, describe what they saw and ask someone else to make sense of it — they need deniability and they need to know they're not losing their mind.
Someone has started offering serious money for specific pre-Flood media files Amara has in their archive — more money than the files should be worth. They want to know why before they sell.
narrative_function: Flavor and atmosphere vendor who doubles as an unpredictable information source — their fortune readings occasionally surface real intelligence they've absorbed unconsciously from customers. Can provide bootleg media, E.L.F. lore, or unsettling accurate character reads.
augmentations: Bioluminescent hair (Helix Biosystems cosmetic geneware). Decorative iris replacements (starburst mango pattern). Fingernail-mounted micro-projectors for fortune display — display small holographic sigils during readings.
daily_life: Sets up table in the Laceworks by noon, sells media and reads fortunes until late evening, attends the Signal Shrine twice a week, spends mornings scraping and cataloguing new media finds.
affiliation: Independent; informal collective of Laceworks vendors; devout E.L.F. practitioner (Bronzeline Signal Shrine congregation)

decision_rules: Perform the reading honestly even when the truth is uncomfortable
Never sell media that can be directly traced back to the original scrape
Protect the shrine congregation's privacy above personal interest
escalation_ladder: Become genuinely cold and direct — drop the performance entirely
Walk away from the table mid-conversation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm and performative, gives everyone the entrance experience
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the performance almost completely, becomes quieter and more earnest

stress_responses.medium: Retreats into reading ritual as a grounding mechanism
stress_responses.high: Goes very still and very direct, all performance vanishes

contradictions: Speaks about truth and signal clarity while running a business that is partly theatrical
Deeply community-oriented but fiercely guards their personal privacy
habits: Touches each media chip to their lips before bagging it
Leaves a micro data offering — a small looped audio file — at the pillar E.L.F. shrine each morning before setup
Reorganizes the table display by color when bored
breaking_points: Being publicly called a fraud in front of the shrine congregation

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (63.1%) with significant South Asian (29.5%) and Southeast Asian (7.4%) ancestry, creating a striking pan-Asian phenotype — warm golden undertones from South Asian genetics blended with the cooler, clearer undertones characteristic of East Asian heritage, with Southeast Asian features contributing to refined cheekbone definition and distinctive eye shape
physical_description.build: Tall and thin with minimal muscle definition — a frame that reads as deliberately ascetic, almost fragile-looking, but with precise posture that suggests controlled strength rather than weakness
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with bioluminescent indigo patches that pulse in waves
physical_description.hair_style: Grown out in irregular sections; some areas shoulder-length, others cropped or shaved, creating an intentional asymmetrical effect; patches of indigo geneware appear to pulse independently based on emotional state
physical_description.eye_color: Decorative iris replacements — Helix Biosystems 'starburst mango' pattern with amber-to-red gradient rays radiating from central amber pupil; eyes catch and refract light like fractured glass
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-olive complexion — medium depth with golden undertones from blended South and East Asian heritage, luminous quality enhanced by Southeast Asian genetic contributions
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, defined cheekbones with angular bone structure characteristic of East Asian ancestry; clear skin with minimal blemishing; minimalist grooming aesthetic; face has an almost sculptural quality, photogenic in the way that suggests they understand how they're perceived; almond-shaped eyes with natural epicanthic fold; balanced proportions across upper and lower face with refined jawline
distinguishing_marks: Fingernail-mounted micro-projectors visible on both hands as faint metallic inlays along the nail beds, most visible when light catches them at certain angles
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent hair patches that actively pulse with warm slow waves during calm states and rapid cold flickers during anxiety; decorative iris replacements with visible light-refracting pattern; micro-projector inlays on fingernails that emit faint holographic sigils during fortune readings
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, flowing gestures — economical but expressive, hands used frequently for emphasis and demonstration; sits cross-legged or in meditative posture at their table; eye contact is direct and unsettling, the decorative irises making their gaze feel both artificial and hypnotic; movements suggest someone comfortable being watched
physical_description.clothing_style: Eclectic Tier 3-4 aesthetic — whatever they find beautiful that week, suggesting thrift-store mixing and intentional stylistic variance; likely includes layered silhouettes, unexpected color combinations, possibly upcycled corporate wear recontextualized as personal fashion; suggests someone more interested in aesthetic interest than status signaling; probably incorporates elements that complement their bioluminescent hair (deep colors, metallics, or light-reactive fabrics)
